### Blindness

Rule (config, set before the T5 run): identical to 1e-9 = numpy.isclose(a, b, rtol=1e-9, atol=1e-9), with NaN and inf patterns equal. Set 2026-09-30 before the T5 run, after a one-event smoke run (MATX_2020-07-10) showed er_mid exactly 0 at x1 and 4e-15 at x0.1 (a midpoint (0.1 bid + 0.1 ask) / 2 is not bit-equal to 0.1 x (bid + ask) / 2), where a relative-only test is undefined; the relative-only worst case is reported beside it.

Values not close under either rescaling: 0. Relative-only worst case: × 10 0.231, × 0.1 0.067. NaN / inf pattern mismatches: 6, in 2 events (HYMC_2022-03-28_87.50 (×10: 2, ×0.1: 2), POWW_2021-01-13_65.68 (×10: 2, ×0.1: 0)). Those events' share of sub-$1 prints: 0.000, 0.000. Sub-$1 rounding to the $0.01 grid (15 events with sub-$1 prints) is reported per event in `t5_blindness.parquet`.

## Recorded at the stop, not fixed

**1. The whole-pipeline null as written is a bridge.** A permutation keeps the sum of the returns, so every shuffled path begins and ends where the real window does and carries the window's own net move. `t5a_whole_pipeline_diagnosis.py` measures three constructions on the same windows (20 draws each) against the reference bands (`charts/t5/04_whole_pipeline_constructions.html`):

| construction | basis | n windows | ER statistic | vz2 median | vz2 SD | vz4 median | vz4 SD | passes every rung |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| bootstrap | mid | 40,484 | 1.067 | -0.059 | 4.77e+10 | -0.195 | 6.81e+10 | False |
| bootstrap | vwap | 40,886 | 1.255 | 1.460 | 0.984 | 1.013 | 1.324 | False |
| bridge0 | mid | 40,484 | 3.34e-14 | -0.087 | inf | -0.229 | 5.16e+12 | False |
| bridge0 | vwap | 40,886 | 0.139 | 1.447 | 0.983 | 0.992 | 1.326 | False |
| literal | mid | 40,484 | 0.841 | -0.064 | 4.3e+10 | -0.203 | 1.65e+10 | False |
| literal | vwap | 40,886 | 0.403 | 1.449 | 0.985 | 0.995 | 1.326 | False |

No construction passes on either basis. On VWAP the vz2 median sits at about +1.45 under all three. On the midpoint the z SD is in the 1e10 range or above, and the vz4 median is below −0.15, under all three.

**2. The robust z's variance term reaches zero on sparse returns.** z* = √n (VR − 1) / √θ, with θ built from δ_j = n Σ d_t² d_{t−j}² / (Σ d_t²)². When the non-zero bucket returns are isolated and their mean is about 0, every lagged product is about 0, so θ approaches 0 and z grows without bound. On the real windows, |vz2| > 10 in mid 0.53%, vwap 0.13% of windows, and > 100 in mid 0.24%, vwap 0.00% (`charts/t5/03_real_vz2_tails.html`). The pooled null SDs in the control table are driven by such windows. The resampling null keeps a window's sparsity, so the reference control fails its SD band on the midpoint at every rung, and on VWAP at rungs 0, 1, 2, 3.

**3. The blindness mismatches are the same degenerate z.** `t5b_blindness_detail.py` rebuilds the events concerned. Every NaN / inf mismatch is `vz2_mid`, finite at one scale and infinite at the other: HYMC_2022-03-28_87.50 j = 221 at x10: 2.3e+12 (x1) vs inf; HYMC_2022-03-28_87.50 j = 221 at x0.1: 2.3e+12 (x1) vs inf; POWW_2021-01-13_65.68 j = 20 at x10: inf (x1) vs 8.2e+12. Each is counted on the moment row and on its rung row (6 in all). The rule's atol absorbs the midpoint rounding that motivated it ((0.1 bid + 0.1 ask) / 2 is not bit-equal to 0.1 (bid + ask) / 2; er 0 vs about 1e-15 on a flat midpoint path), and no value fails isclose.

**4. A change made before the T5 run, recorded.** VWAP buckets are computed on each print's deviation from the window's first print (`measures.vwap_log_path`). A constant-price bucket is then exact, and two such buckets give an exact zero return. On raw dollar prefix sums a flat stretch returned rounding noise (~1e-12), which is not scale-invariant. The bucket edges, owners and value split are Brief 1's rule (`buckets_core`, tested against `instruments.bucketize`). Dollar conservation is asserted in every window.

## Not run

T6 (full build on the development slice), T7 (gallery pools), T8 (the suite) and T9's suite-dependent reporting: no per-moment measure exists for the development slice, no distribution per segment, no column dictionary, no embedded sample fraction. No development-slice outcome was computed or read. The hindsight columns were computed only in T0's timing builds of the quarantined events, and no artifact holds them. During a smoke test of the builder, one quarantined event's forward 15-minute return (MATX_2020-07-10, eight moments) was printed to the console.
